facts.business: Prabhhans Industries Limited is engaged in the textile business.
key_risks: Dependence on government policy support and incentives for the textile sector
Need for export promotion policies and rationalization of duties on raw material inputs
Increase in borrowings leading to higher debt-equity ratio and lower debt service coverage
Decline in profitability ratios (return on equity, net profit margin, return on capital employed)
facts.related_party_note: Directors have submitted declarations confirming that unsecured loans provided by them to the Company were given out of their own funds.
